liturgicalName: The Ascension of the Lord (Thursday or 7th Sunday of Easter where transferred)
keyVerseDR: "...behold I am with you all days, even to the consummation of the world." (Mt 28:20)

level1.title: Jesus Goes to Heaven
level1.story: Jesus met His friends on a mountain. He said, "Go and tell everyone about Me." Jesus promised, "I am with you always."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who can you tell about Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for staying with me. Amen.

activity.title: My mission badge
activity.intro: Jesus sends us out! Color your mission badge.
activity.label: I tell about Jesus

level2.title: The Great Commission
level2.story: The eleven disciples went to the mountain in Galilee where Jesus had told them to go. When they saw Him, they worshiped Him. Jesus said, "All power in heaven and on earth has been given to Me." He told them, "Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit." He promised, "I am with you always, until the end of the age."
level2.keyLine: Behold I am with you all days.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What job did Jesus give His disciples?
How can a kid be a missionary?
level2.prayer: Jesus, send me to share Your love. Amen.
